title: Idealized reduction in analytical data read
method: Synthetic 100 GiB dataset assumes ten equally sized columns. Selecting two gives 100×2/10=20 GiB; skipping 90% of projected data gives 2 GiB. Ignores metadata, compression differences and incomplete pushdown. Not an observed benchmark.
alt: Idealized reduction in analytical data read. All columns: 100 GiB; Two of ten columns: 20 GiB; After row-group pruning: 2 GiB. Illustrative values.
